purpose: Life-safety cross-domain anomaly detection, corroboration, uncertainty preservation, operator warning, and authorized handoff.
principles: An anomaly is not an attribution.
Repeated copies from one source family do not count as independent corroboration.
Modeled evidence alone cannot create an urgent event.
Hostile intent, actor identity, and nationality remain unknown unless established by an authorized trusted source.
External life-safety escalation preserves human or authorized-official gates.
Collect and retain the minimum data needed for correlation and provenance.
